name: Reflections in Amber
detailed_description:
Reflections in Amber is an updated and extended version of a short detective visual novel which placed in the top 10 at the Ukrainian Visual Novels Jam 2022.

Step into a tale woven with intrigue, mystery, and hidden motives. Journey to the secluded village of Brightmere, lost in a sea of forest and fog. Together with seasoned Detective Redbreast, you must unravel the truth behind the sudden death of a local resident. Armed with a supernatural ability to slow time using an old camera, you'll uncover details invisible to the naked eye. One fateful night, one real culprit, and five possible endings await!

---

Features

Detective Story. Dive deep into a psychological investigation in a remote village where every clue matters and each character hides something beneath the surface. Only curiosity, persistence, logic—and a bit of luck—can lead you to the truth.

Choices Matter. The village of Brightmere is alive and responsive to your decisions. The path you forge through your choices will determine the direction of the story and lead you to one of five unique endings.

Mystical Abilities. Use the powers of an old camera to slow time and reveal hidden opportunities or secret paths. But choose wisely—film is limited, and there’s no way to get more in the village.

Deeply Personal Journey. Reflections in Amber is a metaphor for running from oneself and finding the strength to confront personal demons. Investigating a death is only part of the challenge. The bigger question is, if Redbreast can find a way to mend her own life?

Striking Visuals. Though the village may be forgotten by the world, its surreal landscapes and mystical ambiance will leave a mark. Each character is rich with personality, and the illustrated scenes hide subtle clues for the observant eye.

Concise Story. Reflections in Amber is a compact yet complete tale—after all, the detective has just one night to uncover the truth. Perfect for one or several immersive evenings of gameplay.

Use an old supernatural camera to uncover hidden paths. Shape the course of the story with your choices!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (DirectX 11 or OpenGL 4.1 support)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GTX 950 / AMD R7 370 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 Catalina or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2.4 GHz) or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU (integrated or dedicated)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 (Monterey) or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 / M2 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU or Apple Silicon
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
